rules.name: single_conv_before_slice_mul_chain
rules.rule: Prefer one Conv pattern detector plus minimal threshold over shifted Slice/Mul chains.
rules.evidence: exp089 Conv proxy 1147 beat exp090 Mul proxies 2200/2848; exp102 confirms many low-cost artifacts rely on one Conv.

rules.name: conv_to_gather_when_sparse_1x1_injective
rules.rule: Replace sparse injective 1x1 Conv with Gather(axis=1).
rules.evidence: Existing channel Gather artifacts cost 10-30; Conv artifacts are usually 160+.

rules.name: depthwise_conv_visibility_guardrail
rules.rule: Do not emit large full-grid depthwise visibility Conv unless estimated cost beats current artifact.
rules.evidence: exp_b011 task037 depthwise Conv cost 441976 despite correct rule.

decision: Use one-Conv local detector as the next lowering primitive, but only with strict cost estimation and shape limits. Start with task185-like tiny lattice/local-mask tasks rather than connectivity/ray visibility.
overfitting_risk: low for catalog; generated Conv rules still require full validation.
